sentence: This project tests foodborne bacterial pathogens from livestock and companion animals for antimicrobial resistance using standardized testing and whole genome sequencing.
This project uses whole genome sequencing, RNA sequencing and comprehensive phenotyping to find the genetic diseases behind non-immune hydrops fetalis.
This project studies how blocking mitochondrial complex I could make cetuximab work better against oral squamous cell carcinoma.
This project builds shared tools for collecting, organizing and analyzing behavioral, imaging, electrophysiology and neural manipulation data across a neuroscience research program.
This project studies how patient navigation programs for cervical cancer screening can be adapted to different local settings.
This project uses computer modeling to study how key complexes in nucleotide excision repair, a pathway that removes DNA damage, assemble and work.
This project tests methods that use deep learning to automatically write documentation for clinical encounters from audio and video.
This project builds a deep learning tool that predicts patient outcomes after arthroscopic partial meniscectomy using knee images.
This project tries to find out which factors in respiratory syncytial virus infection cause inflammation that makes disease more severe.
This project tries to find out what helps bacterial clones spread and persist in a neonatal intensive care unit.
This project develops assays to screen for small synthetic compounds that target an orphan nuclear receptor.
This project handles the collection and analysis of images for Alzheimer's disease research, measuring amyloid, tau, cortical thickness and regional volumes.
This project builds a screening tool for psychological health across the lifespan in rhesus monkeys.
This project tries to find out which neighbouring cells and molecular signals control progenitor cells in tissues.
This project studies how a fusion oncogene promotes cancer cell growth and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in mucoepidermoid carcinoma.
This project studies how a small RNA controls the production of virulence factors in the human pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
This project builds algorithms that use deep neural networks to predict language recovery after stroke in people with aphasia.
This project tries to find out the mechanisms behind heart failure and myocardial fibrotic remodeling.
This project studies how apical constriction, a cell shape change, is regulated in mammals during morphogenesis.
